## Activity

During December 2022, North City Eye Clinic completed 440 captures. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity represents the total number of captures completed by the clinic team during the month. No operational issue is noted beyond the routine leave recorded in the draft report.

## Image quality

Image quality remained suitable for grading overall. There were 6 ungradable image sets, giving an ungradable rate of 1.4 per cent. This measure provides the proportion of captures that could not be graded and identifies the small number of sets requiring review because the images were not gradable. The ungradable total and rate are reported together for clarity.

## Grading

A total of 113 results were graded referable during December 2022. The median grading wait was 2 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and the time from capture to grading for the reporting period. Overall, the report records completed clinic activity, a low level of ungradable images, and the referable results identified through grading.
